clues.text: At Pentecost in Jerusalem, visitors from this city heard the apostles speak the wonders of God in their own tongues.
Claudius ordered all the Jews to leave this city, so Aquila and Priscilla came from Italy to Corinth.
One night in Jerusalem, the Lord stood near Paul and told him he must testify in this city too.
Brothers traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet Paul on his way here.
When Paul arrived here as a prisoner, he was allowed to stay by himself with a soldier to guard him.
Paul wrote that he was eager to preach the gospel to the believers who lived in this city.
When Onesiphorus arrived in this city, he searched diligently until he found Paul.

taken: Here Paul found Aquila and his wife Priscilla, who had recently come from Italy after Claudius ordered Jews out of Rome.
At Pentecost in Jerusalem, people from this island heard the apostles declaring God's wonders in their own tongue.
